To jam the SAVE America Act through, House Republicans tied $10 billion in “election grants” to the same package as war money and farm aid, hoping reconciliation rules will save them. 

That opens a vote‑a‑rama in the Senate, where Democrats can force Republicans to vote on capping Trump’s war powers or restricting immigration crackdowns — exactly the culture‑war scenes the GOP doesn’t want right before midterms.

And the shutdown gun is still pointed at their heads. If they don’t pass a stopgap by Sept. 30, the government closes just before voters go to the polls, and the “law and order” party owns another self‑inflicted crisis. 

The offer to voters is brutally simple: keep a failing war on life support, subsidize the damage to farmers, make it harder to vote us out and bill the future for the privilege.
